maddeler.e:
نصطدم (form VIII)
# نَصْطَدِمُ (naṣṭadimu) /nasˤ.tˤa.di.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# نُصْطَدَمُ (nuṣṭadamu) /nusˤ.tˤa.da.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# نَصْطَدِمَ (naṣṭadima) /nasˤ.tˤa.di.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# نُصْطَدَمَ (nuṣṭadama) /nusˤ.tˤa.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
